segments.text: Elena, congratulations. It's the second time you've got your hands on that trophy. How does it feel?
Yeah, it feels great. I'm super happy and really proud. It's the second time in Stuttgart and the
first time actually won the same tournament, so hopefully I can do it many more times during the
year, but yeah, super happy. What do you think were the key reasons why you won today? That
was a tricky first set, it can be difficult when you get pegged back like Carolina did
to you. How did you get through it?
Yeah, she's a great player and I started much well and everything was going okay. At some
point I didn't hold my serve, she returned pretty good. I feel like her serve also got
a little bit better by the end of the first set and there I was just thinking to survey
it out and then see what's going to happen on the return, just try to fight for each
point and that's what actually happened. A couple second source from her I stepped in
and first set was done which I was very happy with and in the second set it was just more
easier to play. In terms of some of the best matches you've played this season,
how close do you think you're getting to your best game at the moment? It's
difficult to say because here the conditions are not the same as it's
going to be on the other tournaments, it's still indoor, my serve was working
almost the whole tournament really well and I think physically I also
recovered from this long match of course now by the end of the
physical part, the preparation, what we did really helped me and yeah, the most important
is now to play the next big tournaments and I cannot say that it's my best, best form
but I'm definitely going towards that.
What were some of the key turning points throughout this week? Obviously, you had that very tough
late match against Leila where you had saved a couple of match points. What were the
other big moments for you this week?
I would say the most difficult was against Leila, I think it was just overall a very long
day and I didn't start much well and somehow found my way pretty late but in that much
everything kind of happened and then on the next matches I feel like I was more solid,
more focused from the beginning to the end.
Overall, as I say, I think I'm on a good path right now and we are doing a good job
with the team, so I just hoping not to stop and do even better.
And we're right at the beginning of the clay court season, how confident are you moving
into some of those other big tournaments coming up, Madrid, Rome and of course, Roland Garros?
Yeah, wins are always giving you confidence, so it's great that I managed to play here,
all these matches, tough matches and yeah, I think matches is the best preparation you
can have and I did some before coming here and now I played four matches so
yeah just looking forward for the next big tournaments. And finally winning
this tournament gets you that little bit closer to the number one spot still a
way to go but is it still something you're thinking about? Not really
thinking about this I know that there is a chance of course for everything but
it doesn't depend only on me and the focus is mostly on my game, on improvement and then
I think everything can happen, everything can click and yeah, hoping that it's going
to be very soon, if not, I'm going to keep on working.
Enjoy the moment and enjoy the new car.
Thank you.
